title: Act: Author nine-slice frame sources and register them for art:generate
description: Pure frame grid builder, FRAME_KIT registry, sources and generated output.
acceptance_criteria: art:generate writes PNGs and manifest entries
technical_constraints: Deterministic script, palette-only art, at most 48 colours
definition_of_done: PNGs exist under game/public/assets/ui/frames with manifest entries

steps.action: Using createGrid, fillRect, outlineRect, shadeRect, rampIndex from ./draw, export buildFrameGrid(spec:{w,h,slice,ramp,border,lightStep,darkStep}):Grid that fills the body with a shadeRect gradient, draws a 1px outlineRect in rampIndex('indigo',0), 1px highlight along top/left and shadow along bottom/right, and a brass 2px corner block of size slice. Export FRAME_KIT: [{id:'ui/frame-bar',file:'bar',w:32,h:24,slice:8,ramp:'wood'},{panel 24x24 slice 8 wood},{plaque 32x16 slice 6 brass},{parchment 24x24 slice 8 parchment},{slot 20x20 slice 6 indigo},{button-normal 24x16 slice 6 brass},{button-hover brass lighter},{button-pressed brass darker},{button-disabled 24x16 slice 6 parchment low contrast}]. Export UI_FRAME_SOURCES mapping each to {id,path:'ui/frames/<file>.png',frames:[buildFrameGrid(spec)]}. Slice must be under half of w and h.
steps.code: export const UI_FRAME_SOURCES: ArtSource[] = FRAME_KIT.map((f) => ({ id: f.id, path: `ui/frames/${f.file}.png`, frames: [buildFrameGrid(f)] }));
steps.expected: FRAME_KIT has nine entries, buildFrameGrid returns w x h grids

steps.action: Import UI_FRAME_SOURCES from './uiFrames' and spread it into ART_SOURCES immediately after the ui/cursor-hand entry.
Run npm run art:generate in game/frontend to write the nine PNGs under game/public/assets/ui/frames and merge their image entries (with dimensions) into the manifest; do not hand-edit.
steps.expected: manifest has ui/frame-bar ... ui/frame-button-disabled entries and the PNG files exist
